experiment: every CPU-vs-GPU number of the chain cut v5 in one session: one small blob (sq_256), one huge blob (sq_8000_center), the 81 Mpx frame (input_blobs.png), v4's count row (random_1000) and the 240 drone frames; ch07 / ch08 defaults against v4's @njit baselines, with ch05 and ch01-ch03 (v4's cells) as references; GPU configs interleaved per scene, CUDA events, CPU last
timing_note: GPU *_ms: one CUDA event before the first launch and one after the last, kernel-only (the image is already on the GPU and stays there). ch07 and ch08 time their init on the clock; ch01, ch02, ch03 and ch05 reset their buffers on the device off the clock. Every run: image restored, 96 MB L2 flush, sync, ~2 ms sleep kernel queued. 9 interleaved rounds per scene, order reversed on odd rounds. e2e = pageable H2D + pipeline + D2H (perf_counter), context only. CPU *_ms: @njit, one core, end to end of the call (allocations included, no paint), after all GPU work, in 5 interleaved rounds over every cell (median over all calls; round_medians show drift; cpu_rounds the host load). cpu_over_gpu = njit (v4's baseline) / GPU median; cpu_twin_over_gpu uses njit8 (one blob) or njit_label (many).
